result.keyword: Who are the best personal injury lawyers in Melbourne?
result.markdown:
Yes. I searched current Melbourne listings and 2026 legal-industry rankings. There isn’t one objectively “best” firm—the right choice depends heavily on whether your claim is **WorkCover, TAC/road accident, public liability, medical negligence, or another injury claim**.

### My Melbourne shortlist

| Firm | Particularly strong for | Why I’d shortlist them |
|---|---|---|
| **Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Melbourne** | Work injuries, TAC, medical negligence, complex claims | One of the strongest all-round choices. Doyle’s Guide places Maurice Blackburn in **First Tier** for Victorian work-injury claims and **Second Tier** for public liability; it is also First Tier for medical negligence. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Slater and Gordon** | WorkCover, road accidents, public liability, medical negligence | Consistently top-tier. Doyle’s Guide ranks it **First Tier** for work injury, motor-vehicle accidents and public liability, and medical negligence. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Zaparas Lawyers** | Workplace injuries and compensation | **First Tier** for Victorian work-injury claims and motor-vehicle claims in the 2026 Doyle’s Guide rankings. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Maxiom Injury Lawyers** | Workplace injury, personal injury | A particularly interesting boutique/specialist option. Sach Fernando is ranked **Preeminent** for Victorian work-injury compensation by Doyle’s Guide, and the firm currently has very strong client-review numbers. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Brave Legal** | Complex injury/medical negligence | Boutique firm with strong practitioner recognition. Founder Bree Knoester is listed as **Leading** for medical negligence and **Preeminent** for work injury by Doyle’s Guide. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Arnold Dallas McPherson Injury Lawyers Melbourne** | WorkCover, TAC, road accidents | Strong Victorian specialist firm; Doyle’s Guide places it in the **Third Tier** for work injury and recommends it for public liability. It also has a strong Melbourne review profile. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.liv.asn.au](https://www.liv.asn.au/web/for_the_public/find_a_lawyer_referral_service/web/content/for_the_public/referral/referral_search.aspx?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Gordon Legal Melbourne** | Work injury, public liability | Established plaintiff-side practice, ranked **Second Tier** for work injury and **Third Tier** for public liability in the 2026 Doyle’s Guide rankings. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.liv.asn.au](https://www.liv.asn.au/web/for_the_public/find_a_lawyer_referral_service/web/content/for_the_public/referral/referral_search.aspx?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |


### If I had to narrow it down

**For a serious workplace injury:** Maurice Blackburn, Slater & Gordon or Zaparas.

**For a car/road accident:** Burt & Davies, Maurice Blackburn, Slater & Gordon or Zaparas. Doyle’s 2026 ranking puts all four in **First Tier** for Victorian motor-vehicle compensation. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**For medical negligence:** Maurice Blackburn or Slater & Gordon are particularly strong firm-level choices. Doyle’s Guide puts both in **First Tier**; individual lawyers such as Tom Ballantyne (Maurice Blackburn) and Emily Hart (Arnold Thomas & Becker) are ranked **Preeminent**. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**For a boutique/smaller firm:** Maxiom or Brave Legal are worth considering, particularly if you want a more specialist, lawyer-led service.

One important point: **Doyle’s Guide is a useful peer-industry signal, but it doesn't mean one firm will necessarily be best for your particular case.** Its rankings are based on peer nominations/interviews and firms within a tier aren't ranked against each other. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-victoria/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The Law Institute of Victoria also has a referral service where you can filter by legal issue, **no-win-no-fee**, location and accredited specialisation. [www.liv.asn.au](https://www.liv.asn.au/web/for_the_public/find_a_lawyer_referral_service/web/content/for_the_public/referral/referral_search.aspx?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened to you (e.g. car accident, workplace injury, medical negligence), roughly when it happened, and whether you're already dealing with an insurer/WorkCover/TAC**, I can narrow this to the **3 best Melbourne lawyers/firms for your specific situation** and compare their fees, reviews and track record.
